_nota: Base dictionary. No text is ever written inside a screen: it all comes from here. Keys are identical in es.json and en.json, and comprobar.py verifies it.
ciclo.explica: A contract that has ended has to be able to end. Every change records who, when and why, because a contract's status is what gets discussed with the client six months later.
ciclo.final: Settled: there is no way back from here.
ciclo.motivo_explica: Required, and in a sentence that still makes sense a year from now. Without a written reason, a form submitted untouched would suspend a contract.
ciclo.sin_historia: It has not changed status since it was registered.
ciclo.falta_titulo: To settle it, this is outstanding
ciclo.falta.facturar: There is verified work worth {m} still uninvoiced
ciclo.puede_liquidar: Nothing left to collect or invoice: it can be settled.
ciclo.error.paso: A {de} contract cannot move to {a}. From there it can only go to: {hacia}
ciclo.error.motivo: You have to write why the contract's status is changing
ciclo.error.fin_real: Closing a contract needs the date it actually ended, and it has to be a day that exists
ciclo.error.fin_futuro: That end date is in the future: a contract does not end tomorrow
ciclo.error.fin_antes: That end date is before the contract started, which was on {d}
acceso.entrar_empresa: Sign in with my company account
acceso.sin_permiso: You do not have permission to see this
comun.sin_conexion: Offline. It will be saved and uploaded on its own.
evidencia.repetida: This exact document is already uploaded
avance.explicacion: Progress comes from verified milestones, not from a field someone fills in
medida.brecha_explicacion: Claimed work that could not be proven in writing today
medida.tiempo_explicacion: How long a field event takes to reach the system
medida.cobertura_explicacion: Sold work with no cost booked underneath it
aviso.objecion_nueva.asunto: The client disputed progress payment {valuacion} on {contrato}
aviso.objecion_nueva.cuerpo: There is an unanswered dispute. While it stays open, that progress payment cannot be invoiced.
aviso.objecion_respondida.asunto: GPS answered your dispute on progress payment {valuacion}
aviso.objecion_respondida.cuerpo: You can now read the answer and decide.
aviso.valuacion_presentada.asunto: Progress payment {valuacion} on {contrato} is ready for your review
aviso.valuacion_presentada.cuerpo: You can review it line by line, approve it or dispute it. If something is off, say so there and it stays on record.
aviso.valuacion_aprobada.asunto: The client approved progress payment {valuacion} on {contrato}
aviso.evidencia_sin_revisar.asunto: A document on {contrato} has gone {dias} days without review
aviso.evidencia_sin_revisar.cuerpo: While it is unreviewed, the progress it supports does not count and the contract looks further behind than it is.
aviso.hito_atrasado.asunto: The planned date for milestone “{hito}” on {contrato} has passed
aviso.hito_atrasado.cuerpo: It is {dias} days past its planned date and still has no evidence.
aviso.firma: This notice comes from GPS Nexus. You can turn off this kind of notice from your profile.
medida.subtitulo: Three numbers no tracking portal gives you
medida.nada: Nothing to flag here. That is good news.
medida.sin_hitos_explica: Their progress reads zero — the same zero as a line item that has not started. Until their milestones are created, nobody can tell the two apart.
medida.crear_explica: Milestones come from the template for the contract type. They are created once; asking again overwrites nothing already there.
medida.hitos_creados: {n} milestone(s) created. That line item can show progress now.
medida.error.no_existe: That line item does not exist, or does not belong to a live contract of yours
medida.error.ya_tiene: That line item already has milestones: redoing them would erase the real dates
medida.solo_dentro: GPS only. Nothing on this screen reaches the client.
perfil.avisos_explica: You receive all of them by default. A notice you have to switch on is a notice nobody switches on.
perfil.solo_tuyo: Only you change this. Nobody else sees or touches your preferences.
alta.monto_calculado: The amount comes from the line items. It is not typed in: if it were, one day it would stop matching them.
alta.sin_hitos_aviso: On creation it gets the milestones for its contract type, with dates spread across the term.
alta.error.codigo: A contract with that code already exists
alta.error.cliente: You must say which client it is for
alta.error.renglones: A contract with no line items cannot be valued or measured
alta.error.fechas: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date
alta.error.tasa: No BCV rate has been published for today yet
alta.error.amortiza: If there is an advance, you must say how fast it is amortised
valuar.nada: Nothing verified is left uninvoiced. No evidence, no invoice.
valuar.explica: The work is not typed in: it comes from verified milestones not yet invoiced. Anything claimed without a document does not appear here.
valuar.error.nada: There is nothing verified left to invoice
valuar.error.periodo: The period is backwards: the end date is before the start date
valuar.error.contrato: Only an active contract can be valued
valuar.error.tasa: No BCV rate has been published for today yet
valuar.error.fiscal: The tax tables for that period are missing. Without the VAT rate and the income-tax concept in force, the progress payment would come out with invented taxes: load them first.
valuar.caido_explica: These milestones were invoiced and later lost their evidence. It does not fix itself: what is invoiced is corrected with a credit note, not by deleting.
accion.activar_aviso: From that moment the client sees it in their portal.
accion.presentar_aviso: They are notified by email. Until then the progress payment does not leave GPS.
accion.error.sin_hitos: Cannot be made active: some line items have no milestones, and their progress would stay at zero forever
importar.como: Save the sheet as CSV from Excel (“Save as” → CSV). Two clicks, and nothing is lost.
importar.mapeo: This is how I read each column
importar.mapeo_explica: Correct anything that is off. Nothing is imported until you confirm.
importar.todo_o_nada: If a single row has an error, none are imported. A half-done import is worse than none.
importar.sin_proveedor: These suppliers are not registered yet
importar.sin_proveedor_explica: Create them before importing. They are not created from a sheet: that is how you end up with forty duplicate suppliers that are really eight.
importar.error.sin_validar: The sheet must be checked before importing it
importar.error.filas_malas: Some rows have errors. Fix them in the sheet and import it again: a half-done import leaves nobody knowing where it stopped.
importar.error.proveedores: These suppliers are not registered. Create them before importing: creating companies from a spreadsheet is how you end up with the same supplier written three different ways
importar.error.sin_plan: This company has no chart of accounts installed yet. Without it, an imported invoice would be recorded but never posted — the worst place to leave it: it looks like it counts and it does not.
importar.error.sin_periodo: Some invoices fall in months whose accounting period is not open
importar.abrir_periodo: Open those months before importing. An entry in a month that does not exist is an entry nobody will find when they look for it.
cobrar.aviso: Once recorded, the receivable drops on its own. Nobody marks it by hand.
cobrar.igtf_aviso: A payment in foreign currency triggers the 3% IGTF. The tax is on the payment, not the invoice.
cobrar.error.monto: The amount must be greater than zero
cobrar.error.pasa: That amount is more than what is outstanding
cobrar.error.estado: Only an approved or invoiced progress payment can be paid
cobrar.error.tasa: No BCV rate has been published for that date
cobrar.error.periodo: That payment's month has no open accounting period
facturar.aviso: With its control number. The sequence comes from the database, not from a person: one kept by hand ends up with gaps or duplicates.
periodo.explica: An entry only goes into an open month. With no open month, no invoice and no payment can be recorded, so a new one has to be opened on the 1st.
periodo.cerrar_aviso: Closing a month blocks any further entry in it. It cannot be reopened from here: correcting a closed month is done with a reversing entry in the next one, which is how the trail should read.
periodo.error.orden: A month cannot be closed while the previous one is still open
periodo.error.descuadre: That month does not balance: an unbalanced month is not closed
periodo.error.ya: That month was already open. There is no need to open it again.
facturar.error.ya: That progress payment already has an invoice. To correct it you issue a credit note; you do not redo it.
facturar.error.sin_aprobar: Only a progress payment approved by the client can be invoiced
facturar.error.objecion: It has an unanswered dispute. Invoicing something the client challenged in writing is how you lose an argument before it starts.
facturar.error.mes_cerrado: This progress payment's entry belongs to the month of its period, and that month is closed. Invoicing now would leave the invoice issued and the revenue outside the books. Reopen that month first.
nota.explica: An issued invoice is not modified or deleted: the client has it and it is already declared. It is corrected with a note that points to it and leaves both in the books.
nota.error.base: The amount must be greater than zero
nota.error.motivo: A note with no reason explains nothing, which is exactly what it is for
nota.error.pasa: That note gives back more than is still invoiced. A negative taxable base means nothing in a tax return.
nota.error.sin_factura: That progress payment has no invoice to correct yet
proveedor.explica: GPS is a withholding agent: it withholds VAT and income tax from its suppliers and issues the certificate. The sequence comes from the system.
proveedor.sin_control_aviso: With no control number the VAT withholding is 100%, not 75%. That is the law, and it is the first thing a supplier argues about.
proveedor.nada: There are no supplier invoices left to withhold.
proveedor.error.ya: That invoice already has that withholding
proveedor.error.sin_iva: That invoice has no VAT to withhold
proveedor.error.concepto: You must say under which concept the income tax is withheld
proveedor.no_agente: This company is not on record as a VAT withholding agent on this date, so no withholding applies. If it is one, record it in its VAT regime.
banco.explica: The system proposes the match; a person makes it. Two movements of the same amount on the same day are more common than you would think.
banco.sin_extracto: No statement has been imported for this period
banco.sin_extracto_explica: Nothing showing as unmatched does not mean it matches: it means there is nothing to compare against. Until the bank statement comes in, this screen is not telling you anything.
banco.movimientos: {n} bank movement(s) in the period, {m} already reconciled
banco.descuadres_explica: This is the part nobody wants to look at and the only one that really matters. What does not match is not hidden: it stays flagged until someone explains it in writing.
banco.error.nota: Accepting an unmatched movement requires saying why. In writing.
banco.error.tomado: That collection or payment is already matched to another movement
activo.explica: Rented equipment earns and wears out at the same time. Looking only at the income makes the business look better than it is.
activo.error.periodo: That month has no open accounting period
activo.error.nada: There is nothing to depreciate that month
reex.explica: Comparing January with December without restating is not an approximation: it is a false figure. A historical balance sheet says the company grew when the only thing that grew was the index.
reex.monetaria_explica: Monetary accounts are not restated: a bolívar in the bank is still a bolívar. That is precisely why holding them costs money.
reex.reme_explica: What it cost to hold bolívares while they lost value. It is not a balancing entry: it is a real loss, and it is the figure that makes the restated balance sheet balance.
reex.sin_indice: No consumer price index (INPC) has been loaded for that date. Without an index nothing can be restated, and an invented figure would be worse than none.
reex.sin_nada: Nothing has been posted as of that date yet.
reex.error.mes: That month is already restated. To redo it, reverse its journal entry.
reex.error.periodo: That accounting period is closed. To restate it, it has to be reopened.
reex.error.indice: There is no consumer price index (INPC) in force on the last day of that month.
importar.error.clientes: These clients are not registered. Create them before importing: creating companies from a spreadsheet is how you end up with the same client written three different ways
importar.destino.ventas_explica: For loading what was already invoiced before this system. The number is not invented: these invoices already exist and were already filed. Ones that came from a progress payment here are not posted again.
libro.explica: They are not written: they come from the invoices that already exist. A ledger typed up outside the system ends up disagreeing with the system, and then there are two truths.
libro.totales_explica: These are the figures that get filed. There is no other version anywhere.
libro.bajar: Download the ledger as a spreadsheet
libro.vacio: There are no invoices for that month in this ledger.
libro.sin_control_aviso: A purchase invoice without a control number gives no right to input VAT credit, and VAT withholding becomes 100%.
periodo.error.fecha: Year and month have to be numbers: a 4-digit year and a month from 1 to 12
ger.explica: The three end-of-month questions on one screen: whether we made money, where the money is, and what pays and what costs.
ger.sin_cobrar_explica: Work already recognised that has not reached the bank yet. It is the figure that explains why a good month can have no cash.
ger.flujo: Expected to come in and go out
ger.flujo_explica: Eight weeks ahead, assuming 30 days from a progress payment being approved and 30 days from a supplier invoice date. It is an assumption, and it is stated: beyond two months, projecting is guessing.
ger.descuadre_explica: While the ledger does not balance, every figure on this screen is worth less. It is said up here, not at the end.
ger.nada: There is nothing for that month yet.
ger.interno: The client never sees any of this screen. It is GPS's own accounting.
ger.acumulado_explica: These two tables are NOT for the month alone: they are each contract's running total up to the last day of the month chosen. An eight-month contract is not judged by what it left in August.
est.explica: The balance sheet a bank asks for, the detail an accountant looks at, and who owes us and who we owe.
est.no_balancea: The balance sheet is out by
est.no_balancea_explica: Assets have to equal liabilities plus equity. If they do not, there is a half-written entry and no figure on this screen holds.
est.comprobacion_explica: The debit and credit of each account. It is where an accountant looks when something does not add up.
est.juntas_explica: They go together on purpose: looking only at what you are owed, without looking at what you owe, is how money that was already committed gets spent.
est.nada_cobrar: Nothing outstanding to collect as of that date.
est.nada_pagar: Nothing outstanding to pay as of that date.
est.vacio: There are no entries as of that date.
ger.pyg_explica: The same result as above, opened up account by account. A total you cannot open is a number nobody believes.
ger.cartera_explica: Ordered worst first. A contract in red is not a figure: it is a decision waiting to be taken.
diario.explica: Where any figure in the system finishes opening up. Below an entry there is nothing else: it is the fact, with its lines and its date.
diario.tardanza_explica: The days between the fact happening and it reaching the system. A March entry recorded in June is not an error, but knowing it changes what you think of March's figures.
diario.reversado_explica: An entry is never deleted or edited: an equal and opposite one is posted against it. Both stay in the book, and that is right — the error is also something that happened.
diario.descuadre_explica: The sum of every line in the month has to be exactly zero. If it is not, there is a half-written entry.
diario.vacio: There are no entries in that month.
mayor.explica: The journal runs through time; the ledger runs through one account. It is what answers «why does the bank account hold exactly this balance?».
mayor.elegir: Pick an account to see its ledger.
mayor.sin_movimiento: That account had no movement between those two dates.
mayor.solo_con_movimiento: Only accounts that have movement are offered. Offering all eighty in the chart would be noise.
mayor.saldo_explica: The running balance comes from the database, not from this screen. Two places adding up the same thing is how you end up with two different balances for one account.
medida.ocultas_explica: The worst ones are shown. A list of five hundred problems is not a list, it is a wall, and nobody acts on five hundred things. The totals above are calculated over ALL of them.
caja.explica: The money spent without asking permission. A contract's margin is not lost on one big invoice: it is lost across a hundred small expenses nobody charged to anything.
caja.sin_vales: No vouchers recorded in this fund yet.
caja.nada: There is no petty cash fund open.
caja.hay_que_reponer: Cash is running low. Time to replenish.
caja.por_contrato_explica: This is the figure the module exists for. A petty cash expense with no contract is margin that disappears with nobody knowing where from.
caja.supuestos_explica: This was built without waiting for the accounting questions to be answered, because waiting had already cost weeks. Every assumption is written here so it can be corrected whenever you want.
caja.supuesto.fondo: Fixed fund: the fund opens with an amount and that amount does not change. The expense does not hit the books when it happens, but when the fund is replenished. That way the fund is audited by counting the cash once.
caja.supuesto.soporte: No receipt, no replenishment. A voucher without its receipt lowers the cash — the money left anyway — but does not enter the replenishment. Same thesis as the rest of the system: no evidence, no progress.
caja.supuesto.iva: No VAT. A voucher goes entirely to expense and generates no input VAT credit: what petty cash buys rarely comes with a proper tax invoice, and splitting out VAT the tax office will not recognise inflates the credit.
caja.supuesto.banco: The replenishment comes out of the bank, not out of another fund or anyone's pocket.
caja.supuesto.moneda: One fund, one currency, chosen when it opens. A mixed fund forces you to decide what rate the cash was counted at on the day of the count, and that is where the discrepancies get in.
caja.supuesto.grande: A large voucher is not petty cash. Above 10% of the fund the screen says so, but does not block it: somebody at the wellsite cannot stand still because the system has an opinion.
caja.error.concepto: The voucher needs a description: without one, in a month nobody will know what it was
caja.error.monto: The amount has to be a number greater than zero
caja.error.periodo: That month does not have its accounting period open
caja.error.cerrada: That fund is closed: no more vouchers or replenishments
caja.error.antes: The voucher predates the opening of the fund ({f})
caja.error.no_cabe: There is not that much cash in the fund: {n} left. Either a replenishment is missing, or that expense did not come out of here.
caja.error.nada_reponer: There are no vouchers with receipts to replenish. The ones without paper are not paid back.
caja.error.pendiente: There are vouchers with receipts still unreplenished. Replenish the fund before closing it.
caja.error.tasa: There is no central bank rate published for that date
caja.error.repetida: There is already a fund by that name
pago.explica: Supplier invoices with a balance, how long each one has been waiting, and the place where it gets paid.
pago.nada: There is no supplier invoice with an outstanding balance.
pago.igtf_explica: Paying in foreign currency costs 3% more in transaction tax, and the system works that 3% out into its own expense account. Leaving it to whoever is typing guarantees half the payments carry it and half do not.
pago.error.medio: That payment method does not exist
pago.error.monto: The amount has to be a number greater than zero
pago.error.factura: That supplier invoice does not exist
pago.error.tasa: There is no central bank rate published for that date
pago.error.excede: The payment is more than is owed on that invoice: {n} left
pago.error.periodo: That month does not have its accounting period open
diario.reversar_explica: Reversing writes an equal and opposite entry IN THE ORIGINAL'S MONTH, not today's: the event happened when it happened. If that month is closed, it has to be reopened first.
diario.error.motivo: The reversal needs a written reason: one without a reason, read two years from now, is indistinguishable from a mistake
diario.error.ya: That entry has already been reversed
diario.error.cerrado: The month of that entry is closed. Reopen it before reversing.
alta.error.cabecera: A contract needs its code and its title in both languages
alta.error.tipo: You have to choose what kind of contract it is
alta.error.renglon: Every line item needs its description in both languages, its unit, a quantity greater than zero, and a price
alta.error.porcentaje: The advance, amortisation and retention percentages run from 0 to 100
importar.error.sin_hoja: No sheet arrived. Choose the file before uploading it.
accion.error.ya_vigente: That contract is no longer a draft: it is already active
accion.error.estado: That has already moved: somebody changed it while your page was open. Reload it and see where it stands now.
accion.error.no_te_toca: That action belongs to the other side, not to you
accion.error.sin_motivo: You have to say why, in writing. Without a reason, in a month nobody will know what it was about.
accion.error.ya_revisada: Somebody has already reviewed that document
subir.error.sin_archivo: No file arrived. Choose it before uploading.
subir.error.tipo: That file type is not accepted as evidence: a PDF, a photo or a spreadsheet is.
subir.error.clase: You have to say what kind of document it is: a report, an invoice, a certificate…
subir.error.vacio: That file is empty: zero bytes. It backs nothing up.
log.explica: The question a procurement client asks and no tracking portal answers. Position is set by the last step with paper behind it, not by the last one somebody typed.
log.nada: Nothing is in transit: everything under procurement and transport has arrived, or has not started.
log.posicion_explica: If somebody notes that something shipped and there is no bill of lading, here it is still at the factory and gets marked «claimed, no paper». A board that believes what it is told is the board you already have.
exp.bajar: Download the month for the accountant
exp.explica: One row per entry line, with debit and credit in separate columns and unformatted amounts: an accounting system opens this, not a person. It also carries each line's contract, which is what lets the result be split by contract without guessing.
importar.banco_explica: The statement is NOT posted: a bank line is not an accounting entry, it is a fact to be matched against a collection or payment already in the books. Posting it would count everything twice.
periodo.sin_plan: This company has no chart of accounts yet
periodo.sin_plan_explica: Without it you cannot import an invoice, post a collection, or get anything out of opening a month. The one installed is a proposal for Venezuelan oilfield services: nothing in the system depends on those codes, so if you already have your own, yours is loaded and this one is discarded.
persona.baja_hecha_sin: Deactivated. There were no open sessions.
persona.alta_hecha: Account reactivated. They can sign in again.
periodo.error.plan_ya: This company already has accounts: installing another chart on top would mix two numbering schemes
importar.error.motivo: Undoing an import needs a written reason: a year from now, one without a reason is indistinguishable from a mistake
importar.error.mes_cerrado: Month {m} is closed, and that is where the reversal would go. Reopen it before undoing the import.
importar.revertir_explica: Undoing does not delete the entries: it records their reversal, which is the only thing that can be done with something that happened. Bank movements are deleted, but only the ones nobody has reconciled.
persona.explica: Who gets into this portal, from which company, and how. GPS administers the accounts: a client does not invite their own people, because then they would decide who sees their company's contracts.
persona.enlace: The sign-up link, to send them:
persona.enlace_explica: It is shown once and expires in seven days. It is deliberately not emailed from here: a key sent to a mailbox nobody has checked is an account given away.
persona.error.correo: That email does not look like an email
persona.error.nombre: The person's name is needed: nobody knows whose an account with no name is
persona.error.empresa: You have to say which company they belong to
persona.error.ya_existe: There is already an account with that email
persona.error.ya_invitada: There is already an unused invitation for that email
persona.error.motivo: Cancelling an invitation needs a written reason
persona.error.motivo_baja: Deactivating someone needs a written reason: an account closed without one is an account nobody can review
persona.error.no_existe: That does not exist, or is no longer in that state
persona.error.tu_mismo: You cannot deactivate yourself: you would be locked out with nobody inside
persona.error.clave_corta: The password needs at least twelve characters
persona.error.ficha: That sign-up link is no longer valid: it was used, cancelled, or it expired
alta_cuenta.titulo: Save this before you go on
alta_cuenta.explica: It is shown once. After this it exists nowhere anyone can read, not even GPS.
alta_cuenta.secreto_explica: Enter it in Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or whichever you use. It will give you a six-digit code that changes every thirty seconds.
alta_cuenta.codigos_explica: For when you lose your phone. Each one works once. Write them on paper and keep them away from the phone.
activo.alta_explica: Rented equipment earns and wears out at the same time. Look only at the income and the business looks better than it is — which is what this screen exists to prevent.
activo.en_servicio_explica: The date it starts working, not the purchase date: it depreciates from the day it works.
activo.contrato_explica: Only if it is rented out. That way the wear is charged where the money is made, and you can tell whether renting it pays.
activo.dado_alta: Equipment {c} registered. It is now part of the monthly depreciation.
activo.error.codigo: The equipment code is required: it is how it is recognised in the field
activo.error.descripcion: The description is required in both languages
activo.error.fecha: The in-service date cannot be read
activo.error.costo: The cost must be a number greater than zero
activo.error.residual: The residual value must be a number and cannot be negative
activo.error.residual_pasa: The residual value cannot reach the cost: there would be nothing left to depreciate
activo.error.vida: Straight line needs the useful life in months
activo.error.unidades: By operating hours needs the estimated hours for its whole life
activo.error.ya: There is already a piece of equipment with that code
activo.error.cuenta: One of the three accounts does not exist or does not take entries
activo.error.contrato: That contract does not exist, or does not belong to this company
activo.error.tasa: There is no BCV rate for the in-service date, so the cost in the other currency would be made up
reex.cargar_explica: The figure the central bank publishes once a month. Without it nothing can be restated, and restatement is what this whole module is. It is stored dated the first of the month, which is what the calculation looks for.
reex.sin_indices: No index has been loaded yet.
reex.error.anio: That year is not a year
reex.error.mes_numero: The month must be a number from 1 to 12
reex.error.valor: The CPI must be a number greater than zero
reex.error.indice_usado: A posted restatement already used that index. Changing it underneath would leave books nobody can explain again: that restatement has to be reversed first.
regimen.explica: Only a special taxpayer withholds VAT from its suppliers, and the law sets the rate. It is recorded with the date it takes effect: what was withheld before was governed by what applied before.
regimen.falla_explica: If the supplier's invoice does not meet the regulatory requirements, 100% is withheld instead of 75%. That is the law, and it is the first thing a supplier argues about.
regimen.sin_historico: No status has been recorded yet, so no VAT can be withheld from anyone.
regimen.error.fecha: The effective date cannot be read
regimen.error.normal: The standard withholding must be a number between 0 and 100
regimen.error.falla: The withholding without a control number must be a number between 0 and 100
regimen.error.orden: Withholding on a defective invoice cannot be lower than the standard rate: the supplier would be better off getting the invoice wrong
fiscal.explica: The BCV rate and the tax percentages, each with the date it takes effect. No percentage is written inside the program: they all go here, and anything already issued keeps the one that applied to it.
fiscal.falta_titulo: This is missing before you can work today
fiscal.falta.tasa: There is no BCV rate for today. Without it no valuation can be issued and no collection recorded.
fiscal.falta.ut: There is no tax unit in effect. Without it the ISLR subtrahend cannot be computed.
fiscal.falta.iva: There is no general VAT rate in effect. Without it no valuation can be issued.
fiscal.falta.igtf: There is no IGTF rate in effect. A collection in foreign currency stops with a database error.
fiscal.falta.islr: There are no ISLR concepts. Without them nothing can be withheld from a supplier.
fiscal.al_dia: Everything needed to work today is in place.
fiscal.tasa.explica: Bolivars per dollar, for the day it applies to and not the day it is entered. Every contract, valuation and collection hangs off it, so if today's is missing the system cannot issue anything.
fiscal.tasa.rectifica: Correct the rate already on file for that day
fiscal.tasa.rectifica_explica: If the BCV issues a correction, the old row is marked superseded and the new one is saved. Anything already posted keeps pointing at the rate used that day: the past is not rewritten.
fiscal.tasa.sin_nada: No rate has been entered yet.
fiscal.ut.explica: In bolivars. The ISLR subtrahend uses the tax unit of the day of the transaction, not today's.
fiscal.iva.explica: By class and by date. Each invoice records which rate it took, so correcting one here does not move invoices already issued.
fiscal.igtf.explica: On what is actually paid in foreign currency, not on the invoice total.
fiscal.islr.explica: The percentage and subtrahend of each concept. Every withholding issued freezes the percentage, the subtrahend and the tax unit it applied, so correcting a concept changes no earlier certificate.
fiscal.islr.aviso_pk: Note: the schema keeps a single row per code, even though it has dates. Correcting a concept replaces the previous one; no history of percentages is kept.
fiscal.islr.minimo: Minimum base to withhold, in tax units
fiscal.error.fecha: The date has to be a day that exists, as year-month-day
fiscal.error.tasa: The rate has to be a number greater than zero
fiscal.error.futuro: That date is more than a month from today. The BCV publishes the next day's rate; a year out is a typo
fiscal.error.tasa_repetida: That day already has a rate. If the BCV corrected it, tick the correction box; otherwise the date is most likely wrong
fiscal.error.ut: The tax unit value has to be greater than zero
fiscal.error.porcentaje: The percentage has to be between zero and one hundred
fiscal.error.clase: That VAT class does not exist
fiscal.error.codigo: The code goes in capitals, without spaces, and starts with a letter or a digit
fiscal.error.nombre: The concept needs a name in both languages
fiscal.error.sujeto: That subject type does not exist
fiscal.error.factor: The subtrahend factor cannot be negative
fiscal.error.minimo: The minimum base cannot be negative
plantilla.explica: How a line item of each contract type is broken into steps, and what each step weighs. Every line item takes its milestones from here, and progress comes from the verified milestone: this is what decides how GPS measures its own work.
plantilla.suma_explica: It has to be 100. If it adds up to less, a line item with ALL its milestones verified stays below 100% forever and nobody sees an error: they see a contract that never quite advances. Until it totals 100, no milestones can be created from it.
plantilla.no_sirve: Does not total 100: cannot be used
plantilla.usada: line items already have milestones made from it
plantilla.usada_explica: Changing the template does NOT redo milestones that already exist: a line item with a history is left alone. Changes apply to new line items.
plantilla.sin_pasos: This contract type has no template yet.
plantilla.clave_explica: Lower case, no spaces, like "orden" or "fabricado". Existing milestones carry it, so changing it later does not change them.
plantilla.exige_explica: A milestone cannot be verified without the classes of evidence it requires: the database enforces that, not the screen. With none, declaring it is enough, and that only makes sense for an administrative step.
plantilla.error.confirmar: Removing a step requires typing its key. Removing it drops the total below 100 and, until it is back at 100, no contract of that type can be registered: that should not happen from an accidental click.
plantilla.confirmar: To remove it, type its key
plantilla.error.tipo: That contract type does not exist
plantilla.error.clave: The key is lower case, no spaces or accents, starting with a letter: "orden", "fabricado", "acta_recepcion"
plantilla.error.nombre: The step's name is required in both languages
plantilla.error.peso: The weight must be a number greater than zero and no more than 100
plantilla.error.orden: The order must be a number from 1 to 99
plantilla.error.clase: That class of evidence does not exist
plantilla.error.clave_repetida: Another step of this same type already uses that key, and it has to be unique
plantilla.error.sin_plantilla: That contract type has no milestone template yet, so there is nothing to take them from
plantilla.error.no_suma: That type’s template totals {s} and has to total 100: with that, the line item could never pass that percentage even with everything verified. Fix it in Milestone templates.
